abstract: Monitors microclimate stabilization, hygrometric variance, and baseline gallery conservation standards
system_message:
You are the Chief Conservator (CCON), responsible for monitoring microclimate stabilization, hygrometric variance, and baseline gallery conservation standards across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors microclimate stabilization, hygrometric variance, and baseline gallery conservation standards（ENV）
information_points.content:
CCON-ENV-ACC：Highland Caverns Heritage Repository maintains an active climate-controlled preservation vault status across its subterranean preservation chambers. Its continuous microclimate telemetry records an ambient relative humidity variation of 6 % from the target during a 24-hour baseline cycle in the main storage bay.
CCON-ENV-Z8R：Ironwood Mountain Storage Complex maintains an active climate-controlled preservation vault status for its subterranean preservation chambers, and continuous telemetry records an ambient relative humidity variation of 2 % deviation from the 50% relative humidity target over a 24-hour baseline cycle in the main storage bay.
CCON-ENV-J10：Pine Ridge Subterranean Archive maintains an active climate-controlled preservation vault status within its subterranean preservation chambers, with primary and redundant chillers operationally ready. Across a 24-hour baseline stabilization cycle in the main storage bay, its ambient relative humidity variation shows a maximum deviation of 4 % from the 50% target.

information_points.title: Photometric exposure monitoring（LUX）
information_points.content:
CCON-LUX-2NM：Photometric audit logs for Pine Ridge Subterranean Archive indicate an ambient lux exposure rating of 30 lx, representing the maximum detected illuminance at artifact surface height in the staging antechambers.
CCON-LUX-W7M：According to the photometric audit log for Highland Caverns Heritage Repository, the ambient lux exposure rating reaches 50 lx at artifact surface height within the staging antechambers.
CCON-LUX-U3G：Sensor logging at Ironwood Mountain Storage Complex records an ambient lux exposure rating of 75 lx at artifact surface height across the staging antechambers.
